node.statement: For nodes 1.1 and 1.2, G is finite, row-stochastic, and strongly connected; p_S is a strictly positive stationary probability row and q_S is a stationary probability row. Node 1.3.2 gives q_S=p_S. Both full rows q and p vanish outside S, so q=p, namely row_j(F)=row_i(F).
